questions.text: Karan made the following drawings: Rs. 14,000 outstanding for 10 months; Rs. 16,000 outstanding for 6 months; Rs. 12,000 outstanding for 2 months. Interest on drawings is charged @ 12% p.a. using the product method. Interest on Karan's drawings is:
questions.explanation: product = sum(amount x months) = 260000 IOD = product x 12/100/12 = Rs. 2,600  Correct option B. Distractors: A = charged a flat rate with no time factor; C = used a flat 6-month average on total drawings; D = left out the last withdrawal.
